directive.quote: Replace only its source: file reads and writes become door records reads and writes.

job: hold a door run's lease, cutover and journal receipts in the run and answer them, with the receipts of earlier runs handed in by name

distinct_from.why: Its save(file, lease) wrote the lease receipt to a mode-600 file; this holds the same receipts in the run and answers them. That file leaves with the older owner's door scripts.
Its save(file, receipt) wrote the cutover receipt to a file; the same receipts are held in the run and answered here. That file leaves with the older owner's door scripts.
Its journal(file, receipt) wrote the move's journal to a file; the same journal is held in the run and answered here. That file leaves with the older owner's door scripts.

phrasings: hold a door run's lease, cutover and journal receipts in the run and answer them
hold a door run's lease, cutover and journal receipts in the run
door receipts held in the run and answered
